newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian bond and money market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bond and money market closing report.

text.p: Belgian linear bond futures ended sharply lower on the first day of 1997, hit by a selloff in U.S. T-bonds, which plunged more than a point after unexpectedly strong U.S. NAPM data.
The December NAPM index rose to 54.0 from 52.7 in November, hitting Treasuries and German bund futures, which stood 132 bp lower by 1635 GMT.

But the Belgian yield spread over German 10-year bonds was stable, and even narrowed to nine bp from 10 as OLOs lagged Bunds' fall. Dealers said Friday's opening would depend strongly on today's U.S. close.
